column1: # Interface-level batch for the screen tail: owner is the INTERFACE, so the override family
# renames every implementor, inside and outside the package.
# ui.ActionListener has exactly one method, a(Widget). All 18 screen/*Listener classes plus the
# ui widgets (Button, Container, ScrollPane, ListBoxListener, NextClickListener) implement it.
# game.GameEventListener is a 9-method event API. The names come from GameEventSoundListener,
# whose bodies name each event by the sound they play:
#   a(Unit,Player,Player) structure lost / explosion       -> onUnitDestroyed (unit, owner, killer)
#   a(Unit,Player)        under attack (throttled) + impact -> onUnitHit (unit, attacker)
#   c(Unit)               projectile sound per ammo type   -> onVolleyFired
# The implementor rows in map-screen-remain.tsv stay blank on purpose: this family covers them
# and also reaches NullGameEventListener, which lives outside screen/.
